title: The briefcase with an intact lock
body: The screwdriver lies inside the open briefcase. Its lock is intact, but the metal around the keyhole is bright from repeated turning; a loose key sits in the lining.
rival_reading: A program worker could open an old case repeatedly while sorting supplies; wear around a lock does not show that an office concealed a failed response.
gloss: An opened case keeps a key beside an untouched lock.

title: The seed packet tucked in the fertilizer fold
body: A seed packet is tucked into the fertilizer sack's stitched fold. Its planting diagram is intact; the small panel for mixing instructions has been cut out cleanly.
rival_reading: A county office could remove obsolete handling directions during a routine cleanup; the missing panel does not prove a program malfunction.
gloss: A planting packet survives beside an instruction panel removed from its sack.
